title: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Since losing her family in an accident, high school girl Hinako has quietly wished to die. A mermaid yokai named Shiori tells her that her flesh is irresistible to monsters and promises to protect her until she is at her most delicious, then eat her, which Hinako accepts. As Hinako learns more of Shiori's past and grows close to her and to her fox-spirit friend Miko, she realizes Shiori may be trying to save her.
life_message: Even someone who wants to die can be drawn back toward life by being seen and loved.

content.note: Yokai attacks on Hinako and body-horror moments (AniList Body Horror 48 spoiler, Monster Girl; MangaUpdates Monster/s; Wikipedia synopsis).

A relationship framed around welcoming death (Wikipedia themes).
